text: 【央行三季度例会内容发布 这个提法首次出现】与二季度例会相比，本次例会在表述上有几处调整：将“加大逆周期和跨周期调节力度”改为“加大逆周期调节力度”；新增“综合运用并适时调整货币政策工具”的提法，并强调要“推动货币政策操作框架改革完善”；同时，首次将“六张网”建设列为重点支持领域，并提出汇率市场要“防范市场‘羊群效应’和非理性预期的自我强化”。
text_en: [PBOC releases content of third-quarter regular meeting; this phrasing appears for the first time] Compared with the second-quarter meeting, this meeting made several adjustments in wording: "step up countercyclical and cross-cyclical adjustment" was changed to "step up countercyclical adjustment"; a new formulation was added to "comprehensively use and timely adjust monetary policy tools," and it emphasized the need to "promote reform and improvement of the monetary policy operating framework"; at the same time, for the first time, the construction of the "six networks" was listed as a key support area, and it proposed that the foreign exchange market should "guard against the market's 'herd effect' and the self-reinforcement of irrational expectations."
